question: Find the angle between the planes $x + 2y - 2z = 5$ and $3x - 6y + z = 1$.
explanation:
Normal vectors are $(1,2,-2)$ and $(3,-6,1)$.

Angle between planes equals angle between their normals.

$\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec{n}_1\cdot\vec{n}_2|}{|\vec{n}_1||\vec{n}_2|}$.

Dot product $=3-12-2=-11$.

Magnitude $|\vec{n}_1|=3$, $|\vec{n}_2|=\sqrt{46}$.

Thus $\cos\theta=\frac{11}{3\sqrt{46}}$.
